C0322.title: Barracuda Warns of Surging Advanced OAuth Phishing Attacks Exploiting Protocol Flaws to Hijack Accounts
C0322.summary: Cybersecurity firm Barracuda issued an urgent alert about a global surge in advanced phishing attacks that exploit OAuth protocol vulnerabilities. Attackers craft malicious links to trick users into completing OAuth authorization flows, gaining access and silently taking over accounts.
